revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate, local-only, later converted into a transparent 768x768 PNG
Asset name: achievement_medal_postcards_tier_006
Primary request: Create one premium collectible postcard achievement medal for tier 6, GOLD rank, first gold medal in the final group of four. Based on the Chinese title concept "你说什么都对，My Lord". The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal; one uniform color only, no shadows or gradients.
Subject: exactly one centered circular medal. Inside is a unified funny anthropomorphic postcard/envelope mascot, definitely a rectangular ivory postcard/envelope body with rounded corners and envelope fold lines, tiny cartoon arms and legs, expressive face. Tier 6 gag: the postcard mascot acts like an overly loyal tiny servant, bowing politely and holding a tiny blank silver tray with one heart seal on it, wearing a tiny harmless crown-shaped wax seal on its corner; no words.
Medal border: GOLD rank level 1 of 4: clean polished gold circular ring, thicker than orange, small crown ornament at top, small gems, modest gold sparkle, no side wings yet, mostly circular silhouette.
Style/medium: polished 3D-like mobile game collectible, glossy enamel and metal, cute humorous center mascot, crisp small-UI readability, same family as travel and foot medals.
Composition/framing: one centered medal only, full object visible, generous padding, central postcard mascot inside circular core.
Lighting/mood: warm glossy highlights, deferential and silly.
Color palette: metallic gold border, ivory mascot, warm cream center, small red heart seal; avoid #ff00ff anywhere in subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no foot, no toes, no shoe, no sock, no animal, no human, no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no address lines, no stamp marks, no postmark rings, no watermark, no suitcase, no money pile, no cast shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
